description: Use it when someone asks: what will CBAM cost me, how much are CBAM certificates, what is the cost of importing steel, aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen or electricity into the EU, how much in 2027, 2030 or 2034, how much per tonne, what does CBAM add to my landed cost, do I pay CBAM on this shipment, can I deduct the carbon price already paid in the country of origin, what is the free allocation phase-out this year. Computes the certificate cost for any year of the 2026 to 2034 phase-in under Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as amended by 2025/2083, with the phase-out factor from Directive (EU) 2023/959 Article 10a(1a), all six Annex I sectors, a credit for carbon already paid at origin, and the same basket priced in every year to 2034. The phase-in factor changes every year and is the figure most often wrong.

certificate_price_eur.description: CBAM certificate price, which tracks the EU ETS auction price. Required: this server will not invent a market price.

sector.description: One of: Cement | Fertilisers | Iron and steel | Aluminium | Hydrogen | Electricity
